cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership handover requested by `pendingOwner`.

createInstance(address,address).details: Restricted to the configured {instanceDeployer} (NOT the owner) —      separation of duties: the routine per-market instance minting runs on      a dedicated, lower-privilege deployer key, while ownership (impl +      fees + deployer rotation) stays with the Aspens admin. Gating here      (vs the prior permissionless form) stops anyone from minting      arbitrary-signer clones that carry this factory's address and a      `TradingInstanceCreated` event from it. The account that BROADCASTS the      `createInstance` transaction (the arborter `GetDeployCalldata` flow →      `just deploy-instance`) must therefore be the instance deployer key.`_tradingInstanceSigner` becomes the instance's immutable owner (the      TEE signer). It is supplied by the arborter as its own external      (TEE) signing key, so the deployed instance is exclusively      TEE-owned; neither the broadcasting deployer key nor the factory      owner is the instance owner. The arborter independently verifies,      before registering an instance, that BOTH its signer equals its TEE      key and its `operatorAdmin()` equals the admin the arborter resolved      for that deploy — the latter because the operator admin gates the      operator fee, the per-epoch withdrawal and settlement caps, and      `terminate()`. It refuses to register      an instance where either differs, so a deployer that substitutes      calldata can only mint inert clones.

params._operatorAdmin: the stack-admin key gating this instance's operator fee, caps and        `terminate()` (non-zero, and never `_tradingInstanceSigner`)
params._tradingInstanceSigner: address that will sign for the new trading instance (the TEE)

returns._newTradingInstance: address of the newly deployed trading instance

returns._byteCodeSize: length of the current version bytecode

initialize(address,address,address,uint1.details: Callable ONLY by the factory deployer (captured in the constructor).      This is load-bearing: `initialize` sets the owner and is otherwise      permissionless, so without the guard an attacker could frontrun the      legitimate two-tx deploy (`new` then `initialize`) and take ownership.      Solady's `_initializeOwner` additionally makes this one-shot (a second      call reverts `AlreadyInitialized`).

params._maintenanceBps: maintenance fee in basis points (<= DENOMINATOR)

owner().details: Returns the owner of the contract.

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the owner to renounce their ownership.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

rescueEth().details: Only callable by owner. Ownable functions are payable for gas optimization,      so this function allows recovery of accidentally sent ETH.

params._maintenanceBps: new maintenance fee in basis points (<= DENOMINATOR)

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to transfer the ownership to `newOwner`.

params._newImpl: new implementation to be used for future deployments

constructor.notice: Records the deployer so it — and only it — can later {initialize}         the factory, closing the deploy-time ownership frontrun window.

createInstance(address,address).notice: Creates a new trading instance, baking the current maintenance fee         (recipient + rate) and the operator admin into its immutable args.

currentVersionBytecode().notice: Returns the current version bytecode (alias for interface compatibility)

getBytecodeSize().notice: Returns the size of the current version bytecode

initialize(address,address,address,uint1.notice: Initializes the factory: owner (the Aspens admin), the instance         deployer, and the initial maintenance fee recipient + rate.

rescueEth().notice: Rescue accidentally sent ETH from the contract

setDeployer(address).notice: Rotate the instance deployer — the key allowed to call         {createInstance} (owner only).

setMaintenance(address,uint16).notice: Rotate the maintenance fee recipient + rate (Aspens admin only).         Applies to instances created AFTER this call; existing instances are         unaffected (their maintenance fee is immutable in their args).

updateImpl(address).notice: Updates the implementation contract used for new contract deployments
